$comment: Single source of truth for the Alert API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: alert
title: Alert
description: A message on the page that needs attention: information, success, a warning or an error.

onDismiss.html: <button class="vin-btn vin-btn--ghost vin-btn--icon vin-alert__close" aria-label="Dismiss" data-vin-dismiss>; vinui.js removes the alert

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A title and a description, with an icon.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: Primary for news, then success, warning and danger. Each has its own icon.

examples.title: Actions and dismiss
examples.description: Buttons under the text, and a close button. In HTML, add data-vin-dismiss to the close button and include vinui.js.

a11y: An alert that is on the page from the start needs no role. Give role="alert" only to one that appears after an action, so it's announced.
The title says what happened in words; the colour and icon only support it. Icons are hidden from screen readers.
The close button has an aria-label ("Dismiss"). After it closes, focus moves to the next control (or the one before), so keyboard users don't get lost.
Text meets 4.5:1 contrast on every tinted background.
